messages:
nina_new: Hi all! Day 3. Two onboarding hiccups: trying to register a second YubiKey (backup) in Okta but it says 'This device is already registered' even though I only registered one earlier. Also the onboarding Drive shortcut in my welcome doc leads to 'File not found' — maybe the group share is wrong. Who should I poke?
josh-it: Welcome @nina_new! Ping @it-identity for Drive provisioning. For the key: which key model and did you register the first one as a second factor or as a platform authenticator?
nina_new: First key was a YubiKey 5Ci I registered yesterday on my laptop. Backup is a YubiKey Security Key NFC I bought. Both show up in yubico manager as distinct serials. Okta UI lists only one security key and when I try to add the second it errors.
it-identity: Hmm. Sometimes Okta deduplicates by credential ID if the backup was cloned or if the key was reset with the same resident key. Do you remember if you did an export/clone? Also share the Drive error — is it 'File not found' or 'You don't have access'?
nina_new: Definitely didn't clone. Drive shows 'File not found' when I open the onboarding shortcut link in the welcome email. I do have the Google welcome mail though.
okta-bot: Okta: Activation email delivered to nina@redwood.com at 1772001000.
it-identity: For Drive: I see your account in SCIM but not in the 'onboarding-all' Google group for some reason. I'll push a group sync now. Give it 2-3 minutes and try again. For the YubiKey: can you open this page and paste the string you see after the error? It sometimes prints a short hex ID in the console that helps identify the credential.
nina_new: Okta just showed a small toast: 'This device is already registered (credId: 0x9f4b2c)'. No cloning on my side.
it-identity: That credId indicates Okta already has a resident key record for that device fingerprint. Sometimes when users register via browser A, then register via browser B while logged into same session, Okta's mapping duplicates. Can you try deleting the existing key entry in Okta (settings -> security -> authenticators -> security keys) and re-register both keys fresh? If you can't remove it, I can clear the credential server-side for your account.
nina_new: I only see one key in Okta (the one I registered yesterday) and the UI won't let me delete it (delete button greyed out).
josh-it: Greyed-out usually means it's the only remaining registered FIDO device and org policy requires at least one. Might need a temporary backup method first (app TOTP) to allow deletion.
onepassword-bot: 1Password: 1Password invite sent to nina@redwood.com at 1772001100.
maria-peopleops: Heads up: policy requires at least one active MFA device. If you plan to swap keys, we can enable a temporary TOTP factor to avoid being locked out. @it-identity can assist with that.
it-identity: I'll enable a temporary TOTP factor for you and then clear the credentialId on Okta so you can register both keys cleanly. Also pushed the Google group sync; you should see the onboarding folder shortly.
nina_new: TOTP is enabled now and I have the secret. Thanks. I can delete the old key now.
it-identity: I cleared credId 0x9f4b2c from the credential store and removed the previous key entry. Try registering both keys in sequence: first the primary, then the backup. Make sure to touch them when prompted.
nina_new: Registered primary YubiKey ok. When I try to add the backup it succeeded now — both keys listed in Okta. Nice.
it-identity: Good. I also confirmed the group sync; the onboarding Drive shortcut should resolve now. Please refresh Drive or sign out/in if you still see 'File not found'.
nina_new: Drive link works now, and I got 1Password invite. Quick question: does company policy require marking backup keys in 1Password or labeling them somewhere?
maria-peopleops: Store recovery codes in the company 1Password vault and tag the item 'MFA-Backup'. For physical backup keys, note location (e.g., 'home safe') in the vault entry but do not store private key material. Follow the retention guidance in #eng-security.
nina_new: Saved codes and added a vault note about physical key location. Thanks everyone! Closing thread. :tada:
